metadata.resultSource: Hamilton County Board of Elections official canvass workbooks
metadata.allocationMethod: Official Cincinnati precinct totals are allocated to intersecting SNA 2020 polygons in proportion to polygon area. The current CAGIS precinct reference is used for identifier matching in every year because the results archive does not publish contemporaneous machine-readable precinct polygons. These are modeled neighborhood estimates, not official neighborhood results.
metadata.voteShareDenominator: Votes cast for all candidates in the selected contest; ballot undervotes are excluded.
metadata.turnoutDefinition: Total ballots cast divided by registered voters in the official precinct canvass.
metadata.partisanLabelNote: Democratic and Republican percentages are candidate-ticket vote shares, not voter party registration or identification. Other includes minor-party, nonparty, and write-in candidates.
metadata.presentationNote: The public map displays modeled neighborhood totals only. Precinct geometry is used during processing for area-weighted allocation and is not rendered as an overlay.
